title: Nutty earthy Kenyan cobnuts wrap
description: Snappy and cozy Kenyan dish combining earthy cobnuts with agemono-deep-fry technique, all wrapped in a low-glycemic-friendly lotus leaf.

ingredients.name: Lotus leaves
ingredients.notes: fresh, cleaned, dried slightly with paper towels

ingredients.name: Teff flour
ingredients.notes: all-purpose flour alternative for low-glycemic option

instructions: Prepare the dough by mixing teff flour and water in a bowl
Knead the dough until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces, shaping each into a ball
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 10 cm in diameter
Place a spoonful of chopped onion onto one half of each circle
Add a few pieces of chopped cobnuts on top of the onion
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal
Heat vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 1800C
Deep-fry each dough circle for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown
Drain the fritters on paper towels
